caption: The drawing depicts an ornament shaped like a stylized vertical floral or leaf motif, rendered in brown tones. At the top, there are two large, round, flower-like forms with radiating petals and central circular elements shaded darker, giving depth and highlighting the three-dimensional appearance. Below these forms, the composition transitions into a cluster of intricately carved leaves with pronounced veins and edges, also in brown hues with slight variations for shading and texture. The bottom section tapers into a pointed shape resembling the tip of a leaf or a stylized spearhead. Two circular holes are visible, one in the center and another just above it, possibly indicating mounting points. The background is plain and off-white, and there is handwriting at the bottom of the page.
title: Leaf Finial
